segments.name: Financial services
segments.description: XP provides investment, brokerage and advisory services and trading platforms to retail and institutional clients in Brazil.
segments.evidence: The CODM considers the whole Group as a single operating and reportable segment, monitoring operations, making decisions on fund allocation and evaluating performance based on a single operating segment.

revenueModel.text: XP earns transaction fees from institutional and retail clients trading on its platforms, plus fees for investment and advisory services.
revenueModel.evidence: A limited number of such clients can account for a significant portion of our trading volumes, which in turn results in a significant portion of our transaction fees.
